triage.kind_span: Subscription Rights to Acquire Common Shares.

subject_tickers.span: The Rights are transferable and will be admitted for trading on the NYSE under the symbol “GUT RT”.

security_class.span: Subscription Rights to Acquire Common Shares.

rights_per_share.span: One Right will be issued in respect of each Common Share of the Fund outstanding as of the close of business on the Record Date.

rights_per_new_share.span: Seven Rights will be required to purchase one Common Share.

price_reference.span: Seven Rights may be exercised at a price of $5.50 per Common Share

record_date.span: as of the close business on March 11, 2021

expiration_date.span: which will be 5:00 PM Eastern Time on April 14, 2021

over_subscription.span: An over-subscription privilege will be offered

max_new_shares.span: 7,885,840 Common Shares of the Fund will be issued if all Rights are exercised.

notes: Prospectus supplement dated March 11, 2021. Subscription price is a fixed $5.50 per share (not stated as a percent of NAV or market), so price_pct is null. One passage in the excerpt writes the record date as March 11, 2020 (apparent typo); the summary and the subscription period say March 11, 2021, which is used. Board may eliminate the over-subscription privilege at its discretion; the privilege is stated as offered. Expiration is 'unless otherwise extended'. Subject tickers also include preferred symbols GUT PrA / GUT PrC, not part of this event.
